notes.title: Karisvale Patch Notes 4/7/21
notes.content:
Hey Investigators,

Thank you all so much for playing my game. I just pushed a new update for Karisvale that includes the following:

[list]
[*] Reduced file size (down from 1.5GB to 833 MB)
[*] Dungeon lever no longer freezes player and forces restart
[*] Mac users should no longer be stuck on a black screen after speaking with the Lost Man (let me know if this still persists)
[*] Grammatical fixes
[*] New portrait for Echo (that's actually Echo irl)
[/list]

Please leave a review on Steam if you haven't because that is how Steam will know to promote my game to new players. Thank you all for your kind words and reviews. 

Best,
Brendan ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Karisvale is Back Online, Itch.io Release & Upcoming Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Investigators,[/h2]

After being down for 2 days, Karisvale is back online and available to play.

I'm new to developing on Steam and I hope this wasn't too much of an inconvenience to anyone who was looking forward to solving the mystery of Karisvale this weekend.

Karisvale is also now available to download on Itch.io! (PC only). View it [url=https://brendantighe.itch.io/karisvale]here[/url].

Karisvale will also receive an update this week. So far, it will include the following:
[list]
[*] Minor bug fixes and additional polishing
[*] Various graphical improvements to cutscenes
[*] Increased visibility of text
[*] New character artwork for Echo the Shiba
[*] Anything else that you suggest!
[/list]
I only hope that being down this weekend wasn't too much of a hit to the game's success. Please be sure to leave a Steam review and share the word with your friends, Discord servers, etc. I need your help to share Karisvale with the world!

Until I think of anything else worth announcing,
Brendan Tighe, Game Director
